rules.issued_when: every claim is 'matches' for every validator
rules.refused_when: any claim is 'contradicts'; the same endpoint and claims cannot be re-inspected unchanged
rules.pending_when: nothing contradicted but something did not settle
rules.inspect_by: the operator only; any outcome applies
rules.challenge_by: anyone, on an issued passport, at most once per 1 day(s); only a contradiction changes it
rules.judged_probes: asked in two presentation orders; a disagreement between them is 'inconclusive'
rules.untrusted: every agent answer is fenced ( < and > replaced ) before it reaches the judge
rules.not_a_proof: five independent observers agreeing on behaviour, not a proof of which model answers
